branded.why: The plain yoghurt by which Japan came to know yoghurt, since 1971.

about.text: A plain set yoghurt from the Japanese dairy Meiji, made with two defined strains of the yoghurt bacteria, which its name LB81 is built from.

links.name: Meiji, Meiji Bulgaria Yogurt LB81 plain 400 g (product page)

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: LB81 = the trailing digits of strains 2038 and 1131
Sold as a Foods for Specified Health Uses (FOSHU) product for intestinal balance; Meiji reports improved gut flora and relief of constipation (company research)
